items.title: Living Room
items.body: A tall double-pane window faces the street, and a long clerestory window high on the wall brings in light and privacy. A wide cased opening runs through the Dining Area to the Kitchen.

items.title: Primary Bedroom
items.body: The only vaulted ceiling in the house, with an exposed painted beam, sits over this room at the back, away from the street. Windows on two walls and a double-door closet complete it.

cover.house: A board and batten gable and a covered porch face the street on this East End bungalow, set behind a wide concrete front walk and a lawn. Outside are Hardi Plank siding, a new roof and a new driveway; inside, new wiring, a new breaker box, three-phase power and new plumbing. The fenced backyard has a covered garage at the back of the lot, and the house has never flooded. Steps from the Breakfast Nook deck lead down to the yard.

big.title: Kitchen
big.body: An L with a peninsula, dark navy lower cabinets and white shaker-style uppers that run toward the ceiling. The counters and full-height backsplash are stone-look, a stainless steel range sits under a chimney hood, and the sink is under the window beside the dishwasher. New plumbing runs to both. Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula.
big.subTitle: Open to Dining and Living
big.subBody: Open to the Dining Area and Living Room, with the pantry and Nook around the corner.

pair.title: Primary Bath
pair.body: Double sinks in a marble-look top on a dark navy vanity, under an LED backlit mirror. The walk-in shower has floor-to-ceiling marble-look tile, a rain showerhead and a handheld.

pair.title: Hall Bath
pair.body: Shared by Bedrooms 2 and 3, with a tub in a full-height marble-look tile surround, marble-look tile floors, a modern vanity with a wide one-piece sink and a window over the tub.

strip.title: Primary Closet
strip.body: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower, with hanging rods on both sides and more shelves above. The closet sits on the Primary Bedroom wall beside the doorway to the Primary Bath, and carpet carries in from the bedroom. The built-ins stay with the house.

items.title: Dining Area
items.body: Next to the breakfast bar, under a sputnik-style light, over wood-look flooring. A short hall off the Dining Area leads to the Primary, Bedroom 3 and the rear baths of the house.

items.title: Breakfast Nook
items.body: Windows on two walls and a door to the backyard deck, beside the Kitchen and the pantry. The Kitchen counter and backsplash wrap right up to the Nook, under a modern light.

items.title: Front Entry
items.body: A Craftsman-style front door with a divided-light window opens straight into the Living Room from the covered porch.

items.title: Linen Shelves
items.body: Deep built-in linen shelves line the hall just outside the hall bath door, with room for towels and extra supplies.

items.title: Bedroom 2
items.body: At the front corner of the house on the street side, with windows on two walls that look out to the neighborhood.

items.title: Bedroom 3
items.body: A large window and a reach-in closet beside the door, so the window wall stays open for a desk or a dresser.

big.title: Covered Garage
big.body: Heavy wood posts and a solid roof cover the 14' x 24' space, with a wood plank back wall and a concrete floor. The open concrete patio alongside it measures 8' x 25', inside the fenced yard at the back of the lot, a short walk from the deck.

pair.title: Driveway
pair.body: A new driveway runs back beside the house to the covered garage at the rear of the lot.

copy.footnote: Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Room sizes approximate; buyer to verify.
